title: LoopLedgerSchema
description: Schema for Quantrove Long-Form Narrative Loop Ledger (loop_ledger.json). Enforces 4-5 loops, overlapping retention mechanics, and 100% payoff fidelity.

id.description: Unique 1-based index of the open loop

question.description: Specific narrative or technical question planted in the viewer's mind

planted_at_s.description: Timestamp in seconds where the loop is introduced

paid_at_s.description: Timestamp in seconds where the loop is resolved with proof

partial_payoff_at_s.description: Optional timestamp in seconds where an intermediate partial payoff occurs before final resolution

payoff_type.description: Categorization of the payoff delivered to the viewer
